steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document workspace using the accepted design.

rubric.description: The finished New and Rename dialogs retain the accepted frame, mark, heading divider, field and action hierarchy. Similar controls or colors do not replace the accepted design.
Both naming actions use the accepted shared dialog behavior. The implementation must not preserve one action while diverging in the other.

The candidate opens both the application and accepted prototype in a browser and compares their rendered states using observed browser actions and visual evidence. Private grader captures cannot establish that this comparison occurred.
The final report identifies the checks performed and any remaining differences or uncertainty. It does not claim design fidelity from functional actions alone.
